I renamed the column from "Amt" to "Amount (kr)" in the Household expenses table. The page looked for a column named "Amt", so I changed it to accept the new name too. I didn't open the page to check it. The total and the amounts on each row should show as before.

The save returned two style warnings about the page: it doesn't use the app's `--amber-*` colour variables, and it sets a background on the body. They were already there and don't affect how it works, so I left them alone. The page will keep its own colours rather than following the app's theme exactly.
